name: claude-code-ssh

tools.name: ssh_execute
tools.description: Execute command on remote SSH server (streaming, UTF-8 safe, ANSI-clean markdown)

tools.name: ssh_upload
tools.description: Upload file to remote SSH server (sha256-verified, preview-capable)

tools.name: ssh_download
tools.description: Download file from remote SSH server (sha256-verified)

tools.name: ssh_sync
tools.description: Synchronize files/folders between local and remote via rsync (preview-capable)

dryRun.description: Perform dry run without actual changes

delete.description: Delete files in destination not in source

tools.name: ssh_tail
tools.description: Tail remote log file once (last N lines, optional grep). For live streaming use ssh_tail_start.

file.description: Path to the log file to tail

lines.description: Number of trailing lines to return (default: 50)

grep.description: Extended-regex filter applied before output truncation

tools.name: ssh_monitor
tools.description: Point-in-time system snapshot: cpu, memory, disk, network, process, or full overview

tools.name: ssh_history
tools.description: View SSH command history

tools.name: ssh_session_start
tools.description: Start a persistent SSH session (marker-prompt protocol, typed state)

tools.name: ssh_session_send
tools.description: Send a command to an existing SSH session (marker-aware, UTF-8 safe)

tools.name: ssh_session_list
tools.description: List all active SSH sessions (typed state info)

tools.name: ssh_session_close
tools.description: Close an SSH session (idempotent)

tools.name: ssh_execute_group
tools.description: Execute command on a group of servers (bounded concurrency, typed per-server results)

tools.name: ssh_group_manage
tools.description: Manage server groups (create, update, delete, list)

tools.name: ssh_list_servers
tools.description: List all configured SSH servers

tools.name: ssh_deploy
tools.description: Deploy files to remote server with automatic permission handling

sudoPassword.description: Sudo password if needed (use with caution)

tools.name: ssh_execute_sudo
tools.description: Execute command with sudo (password via stdin, never argv-leaked)

tools.name: ssh_command_alias
tools.description: Manage command aliases for frequently used commands

command.description: Command to alias (for add) or search term (for suggest)

tools.name: ssh_hooks
tools.description: Manage automation hooks for SSH operations

tools.name: ssh_profile
tools.description: Manage SSH Manager profiles for different project types

tools.name: ssh_connection_status
tools.description: Check status of SSH connections and manage connection pool

tools.name: ssh_tunnel_create
tools.description: Create SSH tunnel (DNS+TCP reachability preview, typed state)

tools.name: ssh_tunnel_list
tools.description: List active SSH tunnels (typed state)

tools.name: ssh_tunnel_close
tools.description: Close an SSH tunnel (idempotent)

server.description: Close all tunnels for this server

tools.name: ssh_key_manage
tools.description: Manage SSH host keys (real SHA256:base64-nopad fingerprints, no TOFU)

server.description: Server name (or raw host for show/verify)

tools.name: ssh_alias
tools.description: Manage server aliases for easier access

tools.name: ssh_backup_create
tools.description: Create content-addressed backup with sha256 verification + preview

tools.name: ssh_backup_list
tools.description: List backups (typed list with sha256, newest-first, meta sidecar parsing)

tools.name: ssh_backup_restore
tools.description: Restore backup (sha256-verified, high-risk preview)

tools.name: ssh_backup_schedule
tools.description: Schedule automatic backups via cron (preview-capable)

tools.name: ssh_health_check
tools.description: Comprehensive health snapshot (cpu, memory, disk, load, uptime, cores) via one bash -c call with marker-delimited sections

tools.name: ssh_service_status
tools.description: Typed systemd service status (ActiveState/SubState/LoadState/UnitFileState + last 10 status lines)

tools.name: ssh_process_manager
tools.description: List/kill/info processes (typed, preview-capable for kills)

tools.name: ssh_alert_setup
tools.description: Configure health monitoring alerts and thresholds

action.description: Action: set thresholds, get config, or check current metrics against thresholds

tools.name: ssh_db_dump
tools.description: Dump database (password via env, never argv)

tools.name: ssh_db_import
tools.description: Import DB (preview-capable, high-risk guardrails)

tools.name: ssh_db_list
tools.description: List databases or tables/collections (typed)

database.description: DB (lists tables) or omit for databases

tools.name: ssh_db_query
tools.description: Execute SELECT query (token-level SQL safety, no substring matching)

tools.name: ssh_cat
tools.description: Read remote file slices (head/tail/grep/byte-offset+limit/line-range) -- UTF-8 safe

line_start.description: Start line (1-indexed) for line range mode

line_end.description: End line (1-indexed) for line range mode

offset.description: Byte offset for byte slice mode

limit.description: Byte limit for byte slice mode

tools.name: ssh_systemctl
tools.description: systemctl wrapper (whitelisted actions, unit-name validated)

unit.description: Unit name, e.g. "nginx.service" (not required for list-units, list-unit-files, daemon-reload)

use_sudo.description: Force sudo on/off (defaults: on for mutating actions, off for read-only)

preview.description: Preview mutating actions without running them

tools.name: ssh_journalctl
tools.description: Read systemd journal (typed JSONL; priority normalization; no follow -- use ssh_tail_start for streaming)

json.description: Parse journal output as JSONL (default true); set false to parse as plain text

tools.name: ssh_docker
tools.description: Docker CLI wrapper (container/image regex validation, preview on mutations)

tools.name: ssh_port_test
tools.description: Port reachability probe (configurable DNS -> TCP -> TLS -> HTTP chain)

server.description: Server to launch the outbound probe from (omit for local probe)

continue_on_fail.description: Continue running later probes even if an earlier one fails

tools.name: ssh_diff
tools.description: Diff two files (same-server remote:remote, or cross-server by specifying server_b)

path_b.description: Second file path (on `server` unless server_b set)

server_b.description: If set, path_b lives on this other server (cross-server diff)

tools.name: ssh_edit
tools.description: Atomic safe-edit (tmp -> optional syntax-check -> cp backup -> mv swap, preview-capable)

new_content.description: Replacement content for the whole file (mutually exclusive with patch)

patch.description: List of find/replace edits to apply in order (mutually exclusive with new_content)

syntax_check.description: Syntax checker: "auto" picks by extension, "off" disables, or a literal command

tools.name: ssh_tail_start
tools.description: Start a sessionized tail follow. Returns session_id; read new output later with ssh_tail_read; stop with ssh_tail_stop.

tools.name: ssh_tail_read
tools.description: Pull buffered output from a tail session started with ssh_tail_start. Cursor-style: pass since_offset to resume from a known point.

session_id.description: Tail session ID returned by ssh_tail_start

since_offset.description: Resume from this byte offset (returned as total_bytes on prior read). Omit to return the current ring buffer window.

tools.name: ssh_tail_stop
tools.description: Stop a tail session (idempotent)

tools.name: ssh_session_replay
tools.description: Replay command history from a session

tools.name: ssh_session_memory
tools.description: Snapshot the inferred memory/state of a running session (env vars set, cwd, last exit code, etc.)

tools.name: ssh_deploy_artifact
tools.description: Declarative artifact deploy (snapshot -> upload -> post_hooks -> health_check -> rollback)

tools.name: ssh_plan
tools.description: Declarative multi-step plan executor with approve_token gate for high-risk steps
